svg.title: Board: Payments overview
svg.desc: A Board, Payments — overview, during INC-2041. A variables bar sits above a 12-column grid: six stat tiles with sparklines, a POST /pay latency time series in hover-edit state, an SLO burn chart, a psp-api call-duration heatmap showing a hard 2.0 s ceiling, an endpoints table sorted by care, and a state timeline of alerts, config, version and health. All time viewports share a synced crosshair at 12:24.

g.text: ◐ 61.4% left · exhausts in 3 d 4 h at current 1 h burn

No data is hatched, never green
